regime_context: Detector shows a narrowing, low-absorption (0.32) rotation toward defensive/healthcare+staples leadership; Big Pharma is the current headline theme and is crowded (z=1.46) but has high durability (0.84) and full breadth (1.0). Rank/rotation legs carry no forward edge — only the absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control here (gate_helps=true). Given a track_record dir_accuracy of 0.413 (worse than coin-flip on direction), I default conviction to low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Memory, HBM & Storage's loss of eligibility (eligible=false, breadth 0.0) persists — if ranked leader but gate-ineligible for another 10 sessions while Big Pharma holds full breadth, that confirms a leadership handoff toward the defensive complex; a single session reclaiming eligibility with breadth >0.5 would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) is the only validated risk-control leg, and Big Pharma sits in a high-durability (0.84), full-breadth (1.0), hurst_tag=trend state. Crowding (z=1.46) is a sizing caution only, not a fade. Lean overweight as a vol-aware trend continuation, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowded defensive healthcare leadership with unscheduled macro surprise share at 1.0 could unwind quickly; the rank itself has no forward alpha and a crowded leader is the documented failure mode for chasing tops.

falsifier.text: PPH drops below its 50-day average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Trend-gate eligible with high durability (0.80) and solid breadth (0.879); crowding is extreme (z=1.89) which caps conviction but does not warrant a fade. Defensive tilt alignment with the prevailing regime supports a modest overweight lean.
theses.dissent: Highest crowding in the eligible set makes this theme vulnerable to any risk-on rotation; the trend-gate offers drawdown control but cannot call returns.

falsifier.text: XLP gives back 4% relative to SPY over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Trend-gate eligible with uncrowded positioning (crowded=false, z=0.31) and trend health (hurst_tag=trend). Lower durability (0.48) and zero breadth (0.0) keep conviction low; lean reflects the validated gate's drawdown-control value on an uncrowded trend leg.
theses.dissent: Zero breadth means the theme is running on a single narrow driver; durability is low so the trend could fail quickly and the gate only softens the loss.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 200-day average before the check-by date
